recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore legacy Device.operation or Device.association paths for FHIR-32409; any further reason/status terminology changes should be handled under the current DeviceAssociation/Device operation issue family with new work-group direction.
issue_request: FHIR-32409 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. Although the description listed several unbound Device CodeableConcept/code elements, the accepted resolution targeted example bindings for operationalStatus.reason and associationStatus.reason.
initial_application: No source-changing commit explicitly labeled FHIR-32409 was found. The operational reason side was applied through FHIR-36213 and git 50f4a45ebb2b, which created and bound Device operation statusReason terminology with the approved MDC-derived example list. The association reason side was applied through FHIR-40529 and git 902ba6f126/925b08c4bf, which created the DeviceAssociation status-reason CodeSystem/ValueSet and bound DeviceAssociation.statusReason to it.
additional_context: FHIR-38904 later removed active Device association and operation statusReason content and moved association tracking to DeviceAssociation. FHIR-48532 later kept DeviceAssociation.statusReason bound to the FHIR-32409-derived ValueSet while changing binding strength to extensible and adding DeviceAssociation.associationStatus. Adjacent original-description elements are covered by separate issues already represented on the combined branch: FHIR-32563, FHIR-32564, and FHIR-32573.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Active XML has no Device.operation.statusReason or Device.association.statusReason paths; DeviceAssociation.statusReason is active, bound to ValueSet/deviceassociation-status-reason, and its CodeSystem contains attached, disconnected, failed, placed, and replaced. The surviving Device operation status-reason terminology contains the later FHIR-36213 MDC-derived example concepts.
